purpose: Wiki-sourced inventory of PvP items, outfits, equipment sets, rings, weapon/armor enchants, Deep Gems, consumables, and PEN stack sources affecting Mantra Damage Ceiling.
notes: Standard PvP means Overworld or Chime of Conflict; Vow of Iron exclusive relics (e.g. Divine Cast Ring) are explicitly quarantined as legal_standard_pvp=false.
Prophet's Cloak uses the Master Outfit slot, whereas Shock Trooper Specialist uses Head/Arms/Legs slots — both can be equipped simultaneously.
Duplicate Ring stacking exploits and unenchantable-slot bypasses were patched in May 2026.

equipment_and_items.name: Prophet's Cloak (Crippling Darkness)
equipment_and_items.notes: Grants +20% Mantra & non-basic-attack PEN via Crippling Darkness. Compatible with Specialist Head/Arms/Legs.

equipment_and_items.name: Shock Trooper Specialist Full Set
equipment_and_items.extra_proc_note: Conjures Storm Strike (15 Gale/Thunder) once 600..400 cumulative attunement-scaled mantra damage threshold is reached.
equipment_and_items.notes: Requires Helmet + Plate + Boots; Helmet alone gives Volt Draft/Inhale only. Pieces are unenchantable and consume armor enchant slots (May 2026 patch).

equipment_and_items.name: Ring of Casters
equipment_and_items.notes: Stable passive +5% mantra damage. Duplicate ring stacking assumed blocked (May 2026 patch).

equipment_and_items.name: Isshin's Ring
equipment_and_items.chime_note: Patch history notes balance/bugfixes for Chime downside consistency; subject to PvP damage modifier caps.
equipment_and_items.notes: Wiki explicitly states Isshin's Ring stacks with Ring of Casters (+20% combined from rings alone) and is subject to damage modifier cap mechanics.

equipment_and_items.name: Enchant Reinforced Hunger (Candied Fruit / Fish Omelette)
equipment_and_items.notes: Carnivore builds must use Fish Omelette. Exclusive with Brain food.

equipment_and_items.name: Brain Reinforced Hunger (Grilled Parasol Brain)
equipment_and_items.notes: Boosts Nocturnal Gem proc from 10 to 15 (+5 flat per proc), but replaces Enchant food (+5% mantra).

equipment_and_items.name: Strengthening Potion (3 Plumfruit + 2 Browncap, 100 INT + Apothecary)
equipment_and_items.chime_note: Overworld standard; Chime consumable restrictions must be checked in-game.
equipment_and_items.notes: Nov 2025 Version History states damage potion efficiency nerfed by 50%. Self-damage from Browncap threatens >95% HP Perfect Flash without heal.

equipment_and_items.name: Nocturnal Gem (Slotted Deep Gem)
equipment_and_items.notes: Deals fixed 10 slash damage (15 with Brain food) after 1s delay, ignoring damage modifiers. Conservative single-cast model counts 1 guaranteed trigger.

equipment_and_items.name: Insignia Gem (Slotted Deep Gem)
equipment_and_items.notes: Reduces next mantra windup by 15% for 3s (5s CD); improves combo confirmation/DPS rather than direct single-cast damage.

equipment_and_items.name: Grim (Weapon Enchant Debuff)
equipment_and_items.notes: Requires M1s/crit setup to apply +25% incoming damage (+50% posture) for ~6s; unverified whether server treats Grim inside common cap or separate target vulnerability.

all_oaths_pen.applies_to: all damage sources when Oath is obtained

songchant_6_uncollapsed_may31.notes: May 31, 2026 patch note states Songchant Mantra PEN reduced 5% -> 3% per point (18% at 6 vs 15% still shown on Traits page).

excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.name: Divine Cast Ring
excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.reason: Exclusive Relic inside Vow of Iron gamemode; NOT legal/accessible in standard Overworld or Chime PvP.

excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.name: Drowned (Equipment Enchant)
excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.effect: +10 HP, +10 Ether, +5% Damage Vs. Monsters, +5% Monster Armor
excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.reason: Damage boost applies vs Monsters (PvE) only.

excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.name: Equipment Pips & Enchants (Ferocity, Viscosity, Entanglement, Multiplicity)
excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.effect: Defensive/mobility/resource stats (HP, Ether, Posture, Armor, Speed, DR, hunger restore)
excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.reason: No PvP Mantra Damage% or Mantra PEN% rolls exist on generic Armor Pips or Armor Enchants.

excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.name: Scaling Rings (Maestro's, Akira's, Dawnfist's, Prophet's, Rosen's)
excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.reason: Modifies weapon scaling, not mantra scaling.

excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.name: Yun'Shul-Upgraded Wind-Up Resonance (Lv10)
excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.effect: Activates on Mantras up to level 10 after Yun'Shul upgrade
excluded_or_zero_pvp_mantra_damage.reason: Exact PvP mantra percentage is undocumented on Fandom Wiki; flagged as unquantified ceiling lead.
